scenes.title: 2000 UCL Queen Square MRI Gallery: London Black Cab + 25,000-Street 'Blue Book' Map Growing the Posterior Hippocampus!
scenes.era: 2000, Wellcome Department of Cognitive Neurology, UCL Queen Square, London

layout.description: Sunlit high-key London neuroscience gallery featuring a classic **gleaming black Austin/LTI London taxicab scale front & green-badge clipboard**, an unfolded **giant 25,000-street Charing Cross 6-mile radius map**, and a crisp **3D Structural MRI Lightbox** highlighting **Enlarged Bilateral Posterior Hippocampi Scaling With Years Driving** (paired with the **Fixed-Route Bus Driver = Flat** contrast!).

positions.who: Eleanor Maguire (mannequin in 2000 smart British tailored blazer and blouse)
positions.where: standing beside the 3D hippocampal MRI lightbox pointing from the dense 25,000-street London map directly to the enlarged posterior hippocampal cross-section
positions.facing: beside UCL MRI lightbox and London map

positions.who: Licensed London Black-Cab Driver mannequin (wearing official green PCO badge, flat cap, and wool jacket holding 'The Knowledge' route clipboard)
positions.where: tracing a complex 18-turn shortest route across London from memory with effortless precision!

props.name: 6-mile Charing Cross '25,000 Streets / 20,000 Landmarks' map + official Green Taxi Badge & route clipboard
props.period_detail: viscerally communicates the staggering cognitive load of 'The Knowledge'

props.name: Structural VBM Hippocampus Comparison Board ('Taxi Driver Posterior Hippocampus UP vs Fixed-Route Bus Driver & Control')
props.period_detail: packs 2000 PNAS + 2006 Bus control into one crystal-clear visual

actions.verb_sequence: calls out an intricate Charing Cross-to-Paddington backstreet detour from pure memory -> Eleanor Maguire illuminates his structural MRI on the lightbox -> posterior hippocampus stands visibly enlarged, climbing linearly with years driving a cab!

reactions.reaction: tips cap proud that 3 years in the rain on a moped literally grew new hippocampal real estate
notes the anterior trade-off alongside the landmark proof that adult human brains remodel structurally

scenes.wardrobe: 2000 London attire: crisp academic navy blazer; classic London cabbie wool jacket, collared shirt, green PCO badge, and flat cap.
scenes.lighting: Clean high-key Queen Square tall-window daylight.
scenes.recognition_hook: Spend three years memorizing 25,000 tangled London streets without GPS, and an MRI scanner catches your posterior hippocampus physically growing larger the longer you drive!

key_visual.description: a sunlit 2000 UCL neuroscience gallery where Eleanor Maguire points from an unfolded 25,000-street London map and green-badged taxi driver to an MRI lightbox showing enlarged posterior hippocampi

props.name: Flexible Map (Grows!) vs Repetitive Route (Flat) Card

reactions.reaction: see why autopilot repetition differs from active navigation

scenes.wardrobe: London cabbie jacket vs bus driver uniform shirt.
